why: Teams becomes selectable at two players, which issue #281's first binding rule forbids by name: 'Teams mode is not a distinct option for two players because it is equivalent to FFA.' Two players on two teams IS free-for-all, and two on one team is a match nobody can win -- which the one-team Start gate then refuses, so the offer becomes a trap rather than a choice. It is a SILENT defect on the shipped pane: the button simply enables, every downstream mode-dependent row renders correctly, and the match starts and plays; what it costs is a mode that means nothing and a refusal the player cannot see the cause of. Killed by the three cases that drive the pane with a real `.click()` -- chosen over `dispatchEvent` deliberately, because a disabled button IGNORES a real click and HONOURS a dispatched one, so only the former measures what a player can actually do. Scoped to hud.test.ts; expectFailures counts that scoped run only.
